notes: Import accounts: a new tab in More > Link accounts to IGG imports a whole csv or xlsx of email, password and IGG id, in random order, in the background. You set the wait between imports on the screen (default 2 to 5 minutes, at least 0.5). Two accounts of one login are spread out between other logins, an account already in the fleet is skipped, and a stop is continued by loading the file again. If IGG shows its human check the run stops; Apex never answers it.
